title: glandularia rectiloba
intro: Glandularia rectiloba, commonly known as trailing verbena, is a flowering plant native to South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia rectiloba include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, calming the nervous system and reducing muscle spasms, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Glandularia rectiloba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
